async def run(items, read):
    value = None
    for item in items:
        value, key = item
        if value is None:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            value = await read(key)
    for item in items:
        key, value, other = item
        if value is None:
            # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
            value = await read(key)

async def once(items, read):
    value = None
    for item in items:
        key, other = item
        if value is None:
            value = await read()
